title: Update README and user-facing documentation to reflect TypeScript architecture

subtasks.content: Root README.md: Replace Python 3.9+ badge with Node.js 18+ badge and remove Python from Prerequisites section
Root README.md: Rewrite Installation section — remove `pip install -e .`, keep only npm-based build steps from vscode-extension/
Root README.md: Remove 'For Developers' Python section (pip install -e ".[dev]", pytest, black, flake8, mypy) and replace with npm/task developer commands
Root README.md: Remove `ck3LanguageServer.pythonPath` from Configuration example JSON and settings table; update '⚡ Fast' description from Python to TypeScript
Root README.md: Replace project structure tree with actual TypeScript layout (vscode-extension/src/server/{core,lsp,ck3,schema,data,log,utils}/, src/test/{unit,suite}/, data/ YAML files)

Root README.md: Update Contributing section — remove Python pre-commit hook references (Black, flake8); replace pygls acknowledgment with vscode-languageserver ^9.0.1; remove pygls docs link from Resources; update Trait Validation to remove Python 3.9+ requirement
vscode-extension/README.md: Rewrite Requirements to remove Python 3.9+ and `pip install pychivalry`; state embedded LSP server requires no separate installation
vscode-extension/README.md: Remove `pythonPath` from Extension Settings list and all example JSON blocks; remove 'Coming Soon' section (features already shipped)

vscode-extension/README.md: Remove Python Detection from Enhanced Error Handling; rewrite Troubleshooting to remove 'Python Not Found' and 'pychivalry Not Installed' sections; update Usage to remove Python prerequisites
CONTRIBUTING.md: Rewrite Prerequisites to list Node.js 18+, npm, Git (no Python); replace manual setup `pip install -e ".[dev]"` with `cd vscode-extension && npm install`
CONTRIBUTING.md: Update Pre-commit Hooks section to remove Python-specific hooks (Black, flake8, isort); replace development workflow commands with npm/task equivalents
CONTRIBUTING.md: Replace project structure tree with actual TypeScript layout; update PR checklist, Bug Reports, and 'Areas for Contribution' to reflect current TypeScript state
vscode-extension/CHANGELOG.md: Remove `pythonPath` from v0.1.0 Configuration Settings table; update v0.2.0 Enhanced Error Handling to remove Python Detection references
vscode-extension/CHANGELOG.md: Remove stale Roadmap section (v0.3.0, v0.4.0, v1.0.0 targets) and forward-looking 'Coming Soon' items that are already implemented
Verify: Grep all four target files for banned terms (pip, pytest, pygls, pythonPath, Black, flake8, mypy, 'Python 3.9') — must return zero matches
Verify: Run pre-commit hooks on all four modified files to confirm markdown/YAML validation passes
